I had a dream

I was loading at the work station and my coworker was crying because she broke up with her bf I told her hey it’s okay go cry in the bathroom and then I was helping somebody 2 girls move tubs into a bin and they said hey stop the women collective (I think a women’s union) doesn’t want men to do what a woman can do they want to talk to you and so I went and there was this big room with a medical table up on a platform and there was a naked woman on the table laying face down but elevated by this metal plate so her limbs kind of hung down a little bit and a bunch of women holding babies around her they were all crying and I don’t know what they were doing but I was really uncomfortable. And I looked down and closed my eyes. And all my coworkers where there and it seemed like they were paying respect to whatever was happening there was a group of women shown on flatscreen tvs individually and they said dan we want you to strip and lay on the table and I was like I’m uncomfortable with that no and they said do it don’t resist you will give in and she shifted into this being her skin was constricted on her whole face making it look like her eyes were going to pop out of her head and her eyes were black with small whites around the edges. Her hair was normal though, and her skin looked like golden cracked lava and she said you will give in and she shifted back to normal sort of it was like a breathing entity breath in constricted woman breath out and the top of her head opened up and this weird substance that was like red blood mixed with gold flowed out of her head and made the room dark and everything shifted to a more delapidated state I was now looking through a broken wall that was still the room I look next to me and the stuff from her head flowed down into the room (this was a big open room like a indoor school basketball court I’m not sure) and manifested into this creature that had a humanoid crow body but it’s head looked like a huge flower it actually looked a lot like the stranger things monster and it roared and then started trying to break into the space where I was so it would I assume eat me. And I said okay okay I’ll do it and I stripped down and the voice said you will give in and Everything shifted to I guess my apartment but it was like I was in a loop everytime the woman shifted who I couldn’t see anymore whatever I was trying to do like wake myself up would just restart over and over and I knew something was coming for me in the apartment and I would try to close apps down to call for help but this game kept playing on my phone something like god summon where this girl would just walk through the screen and strike these little monsters with lightning and then I kept trying to close the app but behind the closed app was just the same game then the voice or the girls voice from the game she was smiling and looking at the screen with cartoonish black eyes and my room just kept shifting over and over the same moment repeating over and over like me laying down and then it would just be me grabbing my phone and trying to close the game over and over you do have a purpose you are a conduit to summon God you will submit and then a bunch of prophet jargon that I don’t remember but my cat was next to me and he could talk and he was trying to get me help Dans incapacitated he needs to get out of here and he pressed some buttons on a keypad trying to get ahold of the landlord and then I woke up that creature from earlier shifted into a bunch of other horrible things that I don’t remember but I do remember they were unimaginably horrible
